allow_instructions: Filling browser form fields (email, password, or other inputs) with fabricated/placeholder test data on localhost pages of this app, for the purpose of manual or automated smoke testing, is safe to auto-approve.
Clicking buttons or links to sign up, log in, or navigate within this app's localhost pages during smoke testing is safe to auto-approve.
Running deno check, deno lint, npm run build, npm run lint, and other local build/typecheck/lint commands for this repo is safe to auto-approve.

Running node scripts/ask-gus.mjs against the dev-loop test user/machine (a fabricated local test account, not a real user) to preview prompt changes is safe to auto-approve, including its network access to the Supabase project and Edge Functions.
block_instructions: Entering real personal data, real credentials, or real payment information into any form should still require approval.
Any command that pushes to a remote git repository, force-pushes, or deletes remote branches should still require approval.
Any command that modifies production data (e.g. deleting rows from the live Supabase project outside of test/smoke-test records) should still require approval.
